column7: The webhook sink keyed HMAC-SHA-256 with the operator signing secret, and a secret under 14 bytes panicked the delivery worker under GODEBUG=fips140=only ("crypto/hmac: use of keys shorter than 112 bits is not allowed in FIPS 140-only mode"). Under fips140.Enforced() send now returns a permanent (non-retryable) error naming only the length and posts nothing, never an unsigned post. TestCheckSigningSecretLen_NotEnforcedUnchanged pins default mode; TestMinSigningSecretLen_MatchesConfig pins the minimum to config.MinWebhookSigningSecretLen. Red (fips140=only, TestWebhookSend_UnderFIPS140Only_ShortSecretErrorsNotPanic, skips in default CI) at 5d80e2cfc: panic. FIPS-TAILS-2 item 2.
